title: GetInventoryItems - ObjectReference
content:
F4SE Member of: ObjectReference Script

Returns an array of all items held by this container

Syntax:
Form[] Function GetInventoryItems() Native

Parameters:
- None

Return Value:
- Array of all items held by this container.
- Returns none if the base object is not type Container or Actorbase.

Examples:
Function DumpCurrentPlayerInventory()
	Debug.Trace("Begin player inventory dump")
	Actor PlayerRef = Game.GetPlayer()
	Form[] InventoryForms = PlayerRef.GetInventoryItems()
	int i = 0
	int iCount = InventoryForms.Length
	while ( i < iCount )
		Debug.Trace("Qty: " + PlayerRef.GetItemCount(InventoryForms[i]) + "Form: " + InventoryForms[i])
		i += 1
	endwhile
EndFunction
